functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the solution correctly implements the functionality as per the requirements stated in the prompt.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses how well the solution addresses edge cases or uncommon scenarios that may arise during execution.

efficiency.description: Measures the time and space complexity of the solution, ensuring it meets the specified constraints.

robustness.description: Evaluates the ability of the solution to handle unexpected inputs or conditions without crashing.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses the appropriateness of using specific APIs or libraries in the solution, considering whether the task allows their use.

readability.description: Evaluates how easy the code is to read and understand, including variable naming, comments, and overall structure.

maintainability.description: Assesses how easy it would be for another developer to modify or extend the solution in the future.

error_handling.description: Measures the effectiveness of the solution in handling potential errors and exceptions safely and securely.
